cases.title: EvoMap Evolver — OpenClaw Local Self-Evolution Smoke Test v0
cases.category: AI agent self-evolution / experience reuse / local agent workflow
cases.local_role: Install and run @evomap/evolver locally; create failure-log fixtures; run evolver run+review with Hub disabled; evaluate whether generated repair prompts are useful for OpenClaw / Hermes / Codex workflows.
cases.cloud_role: Not used in this phase. EvoMap Hub connection, auto-publish, validator, ATP autobuy, and credits are disabled.
cases.summary: ATL-EVOMAP-9A ships a stdlib-only bundle-curator tool (scripts/evomap_curate_bundle.py) with AST self-check, denylisted signal-name + secret-pattern refusal at spec-time, ID-consistency invariant checks, and visibility hard-coded to private. A runnable sample spec produces a portable bundle draft that passes evomap_inspect_bundle.py + evomap_validate_bundle.py, and apply --dry-run + apply --yes against an isolated /tmp target (fresh git init repo) write 1 gene + 1 capsule + 9 memory-graph signals (5 generic + 4 domain, 0 rejected). Two unsafe self-tests prove the curator refuses denylist + id-mismatch specs with exit 1 and writes nothing. All 7 prior phase validators (5/6A/6B/6C/7A/7B/8A) still ALL CHECKS PASSED (no regression). No Hub / no publish / no credits / no approve / no solidify / no AI API / no network / no real test runners. Kit now has a generator that sits in front of the existing inspect / validate / apply pipeline.

phase_history.notes: Third canonical local-only bundle (repair category) using the Phase 5 kit. Bundle survives apply --yes + evolver run + review without approve/solidify/Hub. Same schema as Phase 5/6A (atl-evomap-portable-bundle-v0.1). The parser is the strictest so far: it refuses .env-shape basenames, Telegram bot token-shape strings, HTTP Authorization: values, API key tokens, and 12+ digit pure-digit recipient-like IDs. Known limitation: apply tool still injects 5 generic bare signals (Phase 5 baseline), not Telegram-specific signals like telegram_failure / proxy_mismatch / delivery_terminal_missing -- future iteration should add --inject-signals-from <bundle> to evomap_apply_bundle.py. After Phase 6B the kit supports 2 intent categories (optimize, repair) and 3 problem domains (tool discipline, systemd recovery, Telegram routing).
